matchedRules.reason: Test-selection logic must prove discovery, mapping, and zero-suite policy.
Steering ownership, seeding, caching, operator context, and release-boundary changes must prove that visible user steering is authoritative and no private repository prompt is shipped.
Current OS Trace gateway and Trace Burn changes must prove authenticated history paging, canonical TraceStore resolution, safe redaction, and OS-owned virtual-list/browser behavior.

Agent-facing OS Explore retrieval, unified investigation-policy, shadow VOI, and E6 controlled-trial promotion-gate changes must prove hard scope, missing-semantic fallback, honest hypothesis/readiness state, neutral reads, explicit relevance evidence, one shared E4 next-action/edit-readiness control, shadow-only empirical E5 VOI abstention/cost math, fixed-sample paired E6 evidence with exact sign-test and required-node safety gates, hosted embeddings, runtime routing, benchmark metrics, and compact/full output without selecting the historically red package-wide OS suite.

OS release orchestration, GitHub CLI resolution, signed runtime publication/promotion, exact local update handoff, default workspace-shell snapshots, and Workspace Edge migrations must prove the focused freshness path without selecting unrelated package-wide OS tests.

Hosted Sites update reconciliation changes must prove canonical D1 route ownership, stale-default repair, lifecycle reconciliation, and node routing without selecting the historically red unrelated OS package suite.
Runtime-bundle distribution harness changes must run the exact runtime-bundle contract without selecting unrelated package-wide OS tests.

Lifecycle updater, managed ingress dependency convergence, Caddy topology reload decisions, immutable release handoff, worker drain/load-balancer evacuation, detached activation, platform restart, and discoverable lifecycle-tool changes must run the exact lifecycle/facade/tool contracts without selecting unrelated package-wide OS tests.

ChatGPT node-routing facade or steering changes must prove top-level nodeId discovery, no inner-input leakage, explicit/default/fail-closed routing, and syntax without selecting unrelated package-wide OS tests.
OS tests that exercise destructive-command guardrails, legacy daemon retirement, or release CLI safety must prove pure/static/dry-run behavior without selecting the entire OS package suite.
Server CI changes must scope lint and typecheck to directly changed Twenty server runtime files while retaining dependency propagation.
Session constructor, canonical guidance, task-start compatibility, and workspace fallback changes must prove the integrated task/work session contract.
